newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Explosion to close Avesta Sheffield plant 24 hrs.
newsitem.headline: Explosion to close Avesta Sheffield plant 24 hrs.

text.p: An explosion overnight at a smelting plant owned by Swedish-British steel company Avesta Sheffield stopped production but operations would be up and running again within 24 hours, a company spokesman said.
Avesta Sheffield spokesman Alf Wedmalm told Reuters the accident occurred at its Avesta, Sweden plant when two or three tonnes of smelted steel ran out onto a water pipe.
"We estimate it will take about 24 hours to repair this. It's not a big deal," Wedmalm said.
There were no injuries, he said.
The company is 51 percent owned by British Steel.
